body.statement: Fix \(\eta\in\mathcal E_{\mathrm{loc}}\). Along any deterministic branch with \((\eta,h)\in\mathcal G_{\mathrm{stab}}\) for all sufficiently large \(|h|\), \(x_\star(\eta,h)=c\mu_a\mu_b\{\kappa^4v_av_b(\mu_a^2+v_a)(\mu_b^2+v_b)\}^{-1}h^{-3}+o(h^{-3})\) as \(|h|\to\infty\), and hence \(x_\star(\eta,h)\to0\). This is a calculation for the deterministic profile and is not a stochastic triangular-array limit under \(\theta\in[-K,K]\).
body.justification: Separating the deterministic endpoint records how the profile approaches complete absorption without mixing an unbounded signal with the bounded local experiment.
body.gap: The strong-factor endpoint in Cardoso, Ferman, and Fernandes (2026) does not provide this deterministic profile expansion.
body.consumer: The endpoint checks that the bounded-local profile has the correct deterministic connection to complete absorption.
